findings.csharp: SourceFormatter.RemoveRedundantControlParentheses places all opening/closing source offsets in HashSet; SourceStyleAnalyzer records pairs in control-arrow order.
findings.slg: removeSourceControlParentheses advances one pair cursor only on its closing offset. A nested pair encountered first can leave a later-listed outer opening behind the byte cursor.
findings.nextVerification: Current CSharp format --stdin of a valid nested conditional-parenthesis probe first; compare selected pairs and validate formatted output; only then modify SLG if mismatch is reproduced.

findings.csharp: TrimStart/TrimEnd/IsNullOrWhiteSpace/IsWhiteSpace inspect Unicode chars; formatted source is validated after transformations.
findings.slg: Nonraw trimLine/lineWhitespace/leadingClosingBraces inspect ASCII whitespace bytes; raw indentation removal uses unicodeIdentifier.whitespaceWidth. Syntax diagnostics run on input before transformations, with no final output diagnostic pass.
findings.nextVerification: Determine accepted Unicode whitespace from current lexer/grammar and compare focused CSharp formatter output before any SLG change; distinguish invalid-source contract and formatted-output validation.
